reviews.comment: He is very sweet and his lectures are kind of fun. The exams and quizzes are online and can be taken at your house. The lecture before an exam is a review lecture. He sometimes lets class out early.

St. Louis is just the best! He teaches so many KINE classes and truly cares about each and every student. He claims he hates to talk too much so lectures are interactive a lot which truly help with understanding tests and the overall lecture.

Best professor I have had in the kinesiology department at A&M! His lectures are interesting and he loves his students to be engaging with questions and real life scenarios. He truly cares about the success of his students in the class, and in future careers. He does in class reviews the class before a test that are extremely helpful! Take him!!

S- tier prof at A&M! Big ATR guy. Makes his classes engaging and fun while teaching. I was lucky to have him while he was a new face on campus and he was the best KINE 427 (Therapeutic Principles) prof ever. Huge fan of this guy. Plays Candyland with for Exam Review with Extra Credit for winners. Best choice for 427, great prof, amazing person.

This class was very interesting and Dr. St. Louis is one of the most caring professors I have ever had here at A&M! I highly recommend him for therapeutic principles. He loves answering questions and included many hands on activities throughout the semester. He also provided review days prior to exams which were very helpful. TAKE HIM!!

12/10 for Dr. St Louis, Ive had him for multiple ATTR classes and KINE 427 so far. I always recommend him for absolutely anything he teaches! He cares so much about your education and your well being. Honestly not a better prof out there than this one! Take him I promise you will not regret it!

Professor St. Louis is amazing! He wants you to be involved in class and takes time to give us hands on experiences for us to better understand the material. We always review before each test which is extremely helpful. He genuinely cares about your success and offers candy in his office! His lectures are interesting and engaging.

Patrick St. Louis is an amazing professor, I wish I could take his class again because it was so interesting. He hates hearing himself speak so he loves class discussions. He also tries to make class fun by getting us out of our seats and actually practicing therapeutic principles. You so have to study, but a lot of his questions come from reviews.
